svg.title: The inspection aperture faces the trace
svg.desc: Make the mechanical aperture attend to a transcript strip while answer cards recede. This directional change should read as research into observation, not an omniscient eye watching the agents.

This directional change should read as research into observation, not an omniscient eye watching the agents.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "aperture", "box": [ 0.3096533333333333, 0.1282, 0.3438933333333334, 0.3968 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true }, { "asset": "transcript", "box": [ 0.0952, 0.5698, 0.644, 0.0576 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "TRANSCRIPT", "label_box": [ 0.0872, 0.6334, 0.66, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "hero", "source": "
**Frame:** Deep black lower panel. The answer cards recede. A new diagram begins with an eye-shaped evaluator icon—not a human eye, but a mechanical inspection aperture—aimed at the transcript path.

**Action:** Attention shifts from solving the task to understanding the observer.

**Caption:**
> NOW THEY NEED TO KNOW WHAT THE GRADER CAN SEE.
